name: Akagi Usana
source: 2nd year student. The head of the Akagi Conglomerate, she has become the chairwoman of Puni Academy due to the sudden death of the previous chairman. She has a secret complex about her height. She lost her parents in an accident at an early age and was raised by her grandparents. She has a poisonous tongue and is always ruthless to the protagonist.
